rows.vgi.doc_md:
## GIS analysis

Evaluate terrain visibility between query-supplied tower/building pairs and inspect DEM elevation, slope and aspect. Distances and heights are metres. Input coordinates have an explicit CRS; DEMs must be projected in metres. Missing terrain yields unknown visibility. Synthetic demo assets ship in the wheel. The main schema exposes demo_input, visibility and dem_cells; the examples schema retains SDK regression recipes.

### SQL workflow

Pass query results to the main schema functions, retaining IDs for joins. Use bundled synthetic data to try the executable examples without network access. CRS, coverage, inference limits and resource bounds are explicit function parameters. The examples schema preserves the SDK regression recipes.
